name: How should I prepare my home before painters arrive for trim work?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before painters arrive for trim work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the painting crew arrives, clear a path along the walls and pull furniture at least three to four feet away from baseboards and window casings. Remove low-hanging curtains, blinds, and small decor items so painters have full access to window aprons and frames. If pets are in the home, plan to keep them in an untreated room or offsite to prevent pet hair from settling onto wet paint. Having your chosen sheen and paint colors finalized before work starts keeps the project moving smoothly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture three to four feet away from walls, take down curtains or blinds, secure pets, and ensure trim lines are fully accessible for prep and paint work.
